title: Add chase target context, auto-win detection, and winning details

requirements.summary: Display second-innings chase target and remaining runs on Live Scoring screen
acceptanceCriteria: When a match has 2 innings and the current innings is the second innings, LiveScoringPage displays a clearly labeled target (e.g., "Target: 151") computed as (first innings total runs + 1).
When a match is in the second innings, LiveScoringPage displays a clearly labeled remaining requirement (e.g., "Need 37 more runs to win").
All new user-facing labels/messages are in English.

file_operations.description: Add shared chase helpers to compute first-innings total, target (first innings runs + 1), and remaining runs for the current innings; keep logic reusable by LiveScoringPage and MatchSummaryPage.

Compute chase context when current innings is the second innings (based on match.innings) using the new chase utility, and render clearly labeled English UI for "Target" and "Need X more runs to win" within the existing header/score section.

requirements.summary: Auto-detect successful chase in second innings, block further scoring, toast success, and navigate to Match Summary
acceptanceCriteria: During second innings scoring, as soon as the second innings total runs becomes >= target, the app shows an English success toast indicating the match is won and by which team.
After the chase is achieved, the Live Scoring controls no longer allow recording additional balls for that match (either disabled or blocked with an English message).
After the chase is achieved, the app navigates to the Match Summary screen for the match (without getting stuck on the Live Scoring page).

file_operations.description: Add chase-achieved detection for second innings: (1) after each recorded ball (and also on load/refresh), if totalRuns >= target then show an English success toast naming the chasing team; (2) prevent further ball recording by extending the existing scoringDisabled/guards and showing an English blocking message when an action is attempted; (3) navigate to `/match/${matchId}/summary` promptly (e.g., after a short delay) without looping. Ensure this does not interfere with existing overs-completion flow.

Extend chase helpers (if needed) with a small, deterministic function to decide whether the chase is achieved given second-innings runs and target, so LiveScoringPage can consistently block scoring and trigger navigation.

requirements.summary: Show target and human-readable match result line with correct win margin on Match Summary
acceptanceCriteria: MatchSummaryPage displays the target (first innings runs + 1) when two innings exist.

MatchSummaryPage displays an English result sentence matching the outcome: (a) if Team 2 chases successfully: "<Team2> won by <wickets remaining> wickets"; (b) if Team 1 defends successfully: "<Team1> won by <run margin> runs"; (c) if equal scores: "Match tied".
The winner heading on MatchSummaryPage remains correct for win/lose/tie outcomes and is consistent with the new result sentence.

file_operations.description: Use chase utilities to compute and display an English "Target: <n>" line when two innings exist; compute and render a single English result sentence using: (a) successful chase => "<Team2> won by <wickets remaining> wickets" where wickets remaining is based on battingTeam.players.length - 1 - wicketsLost; (b) defend => "<Team1> won by <run margin> runs" where run margin is firstRuns - secondRuns; (c) equal => "Match tied". Update the existing winner heading logic to remain correct and consistent with the result sentence.

Add helper(s) to compute wickets remaining (based on squad size and wickets lost) and to build the English result sentence for win-by-wickets / win-by-runs / tie, so MatchSummaryPage can stay simple and consistent with LiveScoringPage chase detection.
